description:
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Sage of Hours.
Soulherder and Remnant of the Rising Star trigger.
Resolve the Soulherder trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Soulherder.
Resolve the Remnant of the Rising Star trigger, causing you to pay {5} to put five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, taking at least one extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

uses.name: Jugan Defends the Temple // Remnant of the Rising Star
